output.review_comment: The code contains suspicious special-case logic for weekend holidays that contradicts the docstring. The docstring states "Holidays are used exactly as given: a holiday that falls on a Saturday or Sunday removes nothing," but the code changes the end-date handling based on whether weekend holidays exist. This appears to be logic added to make test_july_fourth_week_2026 pass rather than implementing a coherent spec. The misleading comment ("Use < instead of <=" when both branches use <=) makes this worse. Either: (1) the docstring needs to be updated to clarify the actual spec for weekend holidays, (2) the test expectation needs review, or (3) the implementation needs to be redesigned without special-case logic. Please clarify what the intended behavior should be and update the code and documentation accordingly.
